description: Reconstruction of lower ground floor side extension and lowering non original floor finish level by approx. 250mm. Insertion of window to rear of closet wing. Replacement glazing to rear elevation. Alterations to rear garden layout . Insertion of doors and window to front lightwell. Delta membrane system and insulation to be installed. Removal of non original panelling throughout and plain plaster walls to be restored at ground floor. Erection of light-weight side-infill rear extension, accessed from landing. Replacement external stairs to rear garden. Reinstatement of fireplace. Refurbishment of front steps at 1st floor. Original door reinstated. Reinstatement of 2nd and 3rd floor fireplaces. Raise stepped-back parapet creating room with sash window above closet wing. Extension set back behind flat green roof, reducing visual impact. Insertion of openable roof light over stairs. Refurbish staircase throughout and replace non-original spiralled spindles and balustrade with square section spindles and new balustrade. New green roof to closet wing. Internal refurbishment.
